summary: Bound Evolution Journal owner reads (/bff/management/evolution-journal) to requested rows by deferring deep mutation review projection hydration until after page slicing and passing already-read decisions directly through the production preconditions callback into GovernanceService, eliminating per-row read amplification.
root_cause: In evolution/router.py, bff_management_evolution_journal hydrated mutation reviews for all decisions upfront before filtering or pagination. mutation_review_projection called mutation_review_inputs which called ReadSurfacePorts.get_evolution_decision_by_id, re-reading the entire decision list from the owner for each row (1 + N owner queries). For N=77 proposals, this caused 78 remote calls and a 30s timeout on focused requests.

solution.router: In services/control-plane/bff/evolution/router.py, construct lightweight mutation review base items in the initial loop using already-read decision fields and defer deep mutation_review_projection hydration to sliced page_items.
solution.governance_service: In services/control-plane/bff/governance/service.py, accept optional decision dict in mutation_review_inputs and mutation_review_projection to reuse existing request-local values without calling get_evolution_decision_by_id.
solution.preconditions: In services/control-plane/bff/command_adapters/preconditions.py, accept optional decision dict in _mutation_review_projection and forward it to GovernanceService.mutation_review_projection without re-reading from store.

acceptance_criteria_verification.ac1: Verified per-request read amplification where 77 decisions triggered 78 owner calls. Confirmed that narrow focused GET decision=evo-sweep-inc-drift-a24770da155d now executes exactly 1 list_evolution_decisions call and 0 per-row lookups.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac2: Removed repeated full-owner enumeration and detail hydration outside returned page. Preserved all authoritative reads, sorting, pagination, and tenant/auth semantics without global caches, extra workers, or schema edits.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac3: Base-failing and head-passing counter tests cover focused originalID (test_focused_decision_read_amplification_bounded) and unfiltered default page across multiple history sizes N=10 and N=50 (test_unfiltered_default_page_read_amplification_bounded_across_history_sizes). Net production line change is +39 lines across the 3 production files, well within budget <= 60.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac4: All existing and new tests pass cleanly with 0 regressions. Verified test_bff_b3_evolution_journal.py (20 passed), test_mutation_review_projection_policy.py (8 passed), test_evolution_router.py (9 passed), test_governance_router.py (8 passed), and test_mgmt_ooda_004_bff_routes.py (6 passed).
